name: MCU Release Order Chart
description: An interactive MCU timeline from Iron Man to VisionQuest in release order, with season buckets for shows interrupted by films, spoiler-redacted connections between titles, an MCU Adjacent toggle (Fox X-Men, Spider-Men, Netflix shows, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.), and Disney+'s official Doomsday watchlist highlighted (switchable) and filterable.
